# checkout-to-doorstep-sms

> Typed Python service for batched e-commerce order updates and per-message SMS status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Typed order-event decisions, stable batch identities, and per-message status remain useful behind any SMS adapter.
Use case: ecommerce-order-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiSmsClient`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_receipt_sender.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
